# Afterimage public kit 2.1

## Contents

- One immutable 75-case, 10,000-point production bundle.
- Offline player, witness verifier, bundle inspector, and family helpers.
- Public normative specifications.
- English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and German presentation packs.
- Separate public CRE conformance kit.
- Separate media kit with logos, key art, social cards, launch copy, press
  documents, and the static landing page.

## Integrity

The production `.afterimage` archive is copied byte-for-byte from the verified
artifact. Public packaging does not alter its BundleId, answer schemas,
verification behavior, score model, witnesses, or receipts.

## Deliberately excluded

- author witnesses and receipts;
- author baselines and private golden data;
- source case definitions and authoring scripts;
- private playtest records;
- solutions and late-game screenshots.

## Publication status

The software and media packages are technically reproducible. Before external
publication, the publisher must complete the license, contact, URL, date, and
legal decisions listed in `press/PUBLISHING_CHECKLIST.md`.
